title: Air-quality monitoring

# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Use a reliable and calibrated monitoring system or equipment that complies with regulatory standards to measure emissions. Include the make, model, and calibration certificates of the monitoring devices in the report.
3. Record the date and exact time of monitoring to allow for matching with any relevant meteorological data.

<|end_of_text|>
